title: Punishment for Murder
text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine. Murder is defined under IPC Section 300 / BNS Section 101 as culpable homicide where the act is done with the intention of causing death, or with the intention of causing such bodily injury as the offender knows to be likely to cause death, or where the act is so imminently dangerous that it must, in all probability, cause death.
punishment: Death penalty or life imprisonment, plus fine

subcategory: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
title: Punishment for Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
text: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine, if the act is done with the intention of causing death or bodily injury likely to cause death. If the act is done without such intention but with knowledge that it is likely to cause death, punishment may extend to ten years, or fine, or both.
punishment: Up to life imprisonment or up to 10 years, plus possible fine

title: Theft and Punishment for Theft
text: Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to commit theft. Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both. In case of theft in a dwelling house, the punishment may extend to seven years under the amended provisions.
punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment, or fine, or both (up to 7 years for theft in a dwelling house)

title: Punishment for Robbery
text: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine. If the robbery is committed on the highway between sunset and sunrise, the imprisonment may extend to fourteen years. Robbery is theft or extortion committed with the additional element of voluntarily causing or attempting to cause death, hurt, wrongful restraint, or fear of instant death/hurt.
punishment: Up to 10 years rigorous imprisonment plus fine (up to 14 years for highway robbery at night)
triable_by: Magistrate of First Class / Court of Session

title: Punishment for Dacoity
text: When five or more persons conjointly commit or attempt to commit a robbery, every person so committing, attempting, or aiding is said to commit dacoity. Whoever commits dacoity shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years rigorous imprisonment, plus fine

title: Punishment for Criminal Breach of Trust
text: Whoever, being entrusted with property or with dominion over property, dishonestly misappropriates or converts it to their own use, or dishonestly uses or disposes of it in violation of any direction of law or contract, commits criminal breach of trust. Punishment is imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or fine, or both. Enhanced punishment of up to seven or ten years applies where the offender is a public servant, banker, or in a position of trust such as a carrier or agent.
punishment: Up to 3 years (basic); up to 7-10 years for aggravated cases involving public servants, bankers, or agents

title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter, or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine. This section covers a wide range of fraud, including online and financial fraud cases.
punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment plus fine

title: Assault and Punishment for Assault or Criminal Force
text: Whoever makes any gesture or preparation intending or knowing it likely that such gesture or preparation will cause any person present to apprehend that the person making it is about to use criminal force, is said to commit assault. Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any person otherwise than on grave and sudden provocation shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or fine up to one thousand rupees, or both.
punishment: Up to 3 months imprisonment, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both

title: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt
text: Grievous hurt includes emasculation, permanent loss of sight or hearing, loss of any limb or joint, permanent disfiguration of the head or face, fracture or dislocation of a bone or tooth, or any hurt which endangers life or causes severe bodily pain for twenty days. Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment plus fine

title: Punishment for Kidnapping
text: Whoever kidnaps any person from India or from lawful guardianship shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine. Kidnapping from lawful guardianship applies specifically to minors (under 16 for males, under 18 for females) or persons of unsound mind, taken without the consent of the lawful guardian.
punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment plus fine

title: Punishment for Rape
text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine. Aggravated circumstances — including offences by persons in positions of authority, gang rape, or offences against minors — attract enhanced minimum sentences, up to life imprisonment or death in the most severe cases under related sections.
punishment: Minimum 10 years, up to life imprisonment, plus fine (enhanced for aggravated circumstances)

title: Dowry Death
text: Where the death of a woman is caused by burns, bodily injury, or otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of marriage, and it is shown that soon before her death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment for dowry, such death is called dowry death. The husband or relative shall be deemed to have caused her death and punished with imprisonment for a term not less than seven years, which may extend to imprisonment for life.
punishment: Minimum 7 years, up to life imprisonment

title: Punishment for Criminal Intimidation
text: Whoever threatens another with any injury to their person, reputation, or property, with intent to cause alarm, or to cause that person to do an act which they are not legally bound to do, commits criminal intimidation. Punishment is imprisonment up to two years, or fine, or both. Where the threat is to cause death or grievous hurt, or to destroy property by fire, or to impute unchastity to a woman, punishment may extend to seven years.
punishment: Up to 2 years (basic); up to 7 years for aggravated threats

title: Defamation and Its Punishment
text: Whoever, by words spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or visible representations, makes or publishes any imputation concerning any person intending to harm their reputation, is said to defame that person. Whoever defames another shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
punishment: Up to 2 years simple imprisonment, or fine, or both

title: Forgery and Punishment for Forgery
text: Whoever makes any false document or false electronic record, or part of a document, with intent to cause damage or injury, to support a claim, to commit fraud, or to enter into a contract, commits forgery. Whoever commits forgery shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both. Forgery of valuable security, will, or authority to adopt attracts enhanced punishment up to seven or ten years.
punishment: Up to 2 years (basic); up to 7-10 years for forgery of valuable security or wills

title: Rioting and Its Punishment
text: Whenever force or violence is used by an unlawful assembly, or by any member of it, in prosecution of the common object of such assembly, every member of such assembly is guilty of the offence of rioting. Whoever is guilty of rioting shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both. If armed with a deadly weapon, punishment may extend to three years.
punishment: Up to 2 years (basic); up to 3 years if armed with deadly weapon

title: Punishment for Extortion
text: Whoever intentionally puts any person in fear of injury and thereby dishonestly induces the person so put in fear to deliver to any person any property, valuable security, or anything signed or sealed which may be converted into a valuable security, commits extortion. Whoever commits extortion shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment, or fine, or both

title: Criminal Conspiracy and Punishment
text: When two or more persons agree to do, or cause to be done, an illegal act, or an act which is not illegal by illegal means, such an agreement is designated criminal conspiracy. Whoever is party to a criminal conspiracy to commit an offence punishable with death, life imprisonment, or rigorous imprisonment of two years or more shall be punished in the same manner as if they had abetted the offence, where no express provision exists.
punishment: Same as punishment for the offence conspired (where no express provision); up to 6 months/fine/both for other conspiracies

title: Cheating by Personation
text: Whoever cheats by pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for another, or representing that they or any other person is a person other than they or such other person really is, commits cheating by personation. Punishment is imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or fine, or both. This provision is frequently applied alongside the Information Technology Act in cases of online fraud, phishing, and identity theft.
punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment, or fine, or both (often read with IT Act provisions for cyber offences)

title: Attempt to Murder
text: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge, and under such circumstances that, if death were caused, they would be guilty of murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine. If hurt is caused to any person by such act, the offender may be punished with imprisonment for life.
punishment: Up to 10 years, or life imprisonment if hurt is caused, plus fine
